appraisal_events.evidence: Taisez-vous, espèce d'idiot, cria le duc au comble de la colère. Qu'est-ce qui vous demande tout ça?... — Ce n'est pas à moi, c'est à Jules.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke erupts in disproportionate anger at the servant delivering routine medical news, only to be quietly corrected that the report came from someone else, exposing his outburst as petulant and misdirected.

status_effects.explanation: The duke's disproportionate, misdirected anger at a servant makes him appear petulant and unreasonable in this local moment.
